say:0:1023101001:0.text: Let go of me! Stay away! ... Help! Help me!
say:0:1023101001:0.source_cn: 放开！别碰我！……救命、救命啊！

say:0:1023103001:0.text: That's where the sound came from!
say:0:1023103001:0.male: That's where the sound came from!
say:0:1023103001:0.female: That's where the sound came from!

say:1:1023104001:1.text: Thank you... My name is Jumeo, Thanks for saving my life!
say:1:1023104001:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们……我叫朱密欧，谢谢你们救了我的命！

choice_prompt:2:1023104001.text: Thank you... My name is Jumeo, Thanks for saving my life!
choice_prompt:2:1023104001.source_cn: 谢谢你们……我叫朱密欧，谢谢你们救了我的命！

say:3:1023104002:1.text: Yeah... Those were the fiercest gruglins I've seen.
say:3:1023104002:1.source_cn: 是啊……从没见过这么凶狠的咕布林，下手可真够狠的。

say:4:1023104003:1.text: It's a long story. These wounds aren't from the gruglins...
say:4:1023104003:1.source_cn: 这件事说来话长，我身上的伤是别人打的……

say:6:1023104005:1.source_cn: 是……是我<sad>心爱的罗丽叶的父亲。</sad>

choice_prompt:7:1023104005.source_cn: 是……是我<sad>心爱的罗丽叶的父亲。</sad>

say:8:1023104006:2.text: Where do you live? Let us take you home... We'll talk on the way.
say:8:1023104006:2.source_cn: 你住在哪里？我们先送你回家……路上慢慢聊吧。

say:9:1023104007:1.text: Thanks, you are too kind... But I really have something important to attend to. I need to go to Southville.
say:9:1023104007:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们的好意……但是，我还有很重要的事情没有办完，我...

say:10:1023104008:1.text: You plan to go like this? All bruised up? Is the matter that important? You should wait and recover.
say:10:1023104008:1.source_cn: 你打算这样一瘸一拐地去南村？那件事情这么重要吗？你不能...

say:11:1023104009:1.text:
I haven't seen Roliet in three whole days. <sad>I'm so worried that I can't eat or sleep.</sad>
I must make sure that she is safe.
say:11:1023104009:1.source_cn: 我已经三天没见到罗丽叶了，<sad>我担心得吃不下、睡...

say:12:1023104010:0.text: Ah, I understand... Roliet's father didn't let you see her, did he?
say:12:1023104010:0.source_cn: 噢，我明白了……你，去找罗丽叶的时候，被她的父亲阻止了吧。

choice_prompt:13:1023104010.text: Ah, I understand... Roliet's father didn't let you see her, did he?
choice_prompt:13:1023104010.source_cn: 噢，我明白了……你，去找罗丽叶的时候，被她的父亲阻止了吧。

say:14:1023104011:0.source_cn: 不敢不敢，我可没有那种“好运气”。

say:15:1023104012:0.text: I-I've put all my heartfelt words in a letter, and Roliet will understand everything when she reads it.
say:15:1023104012:0.source_cn: 我……我把我的心里话全写在了信件里，等罗丽叶看到这封信...

say:16:1023104013:0.text:
Ah, a love letter!
No wonder people say, "Love is a daring adventure". You came all the way here just to deliver a letter.
say:16:1023104013:0.source_cn: 哦——你写了情书！\n怪不得总听别人说“爱情是一场冒险...

say:17:1023104014:1.text: Are you sure you can deliver the letter? Your injuries might be serious...
say:17:1023104014:1.source_cn: 不过你伤得这么重，还能送信吗？

choice_prompt:18:1023104014.text: Are you sure you can deliver the letter? Your injuries might be serious...
choice_prompt:18:1023104014.source_cn: 不过你伤得这么重，还能送信吗？

say:19:1023104015:1.text: Hey, I never said we wouldn't help him! This will be easy. We're passing through Southville anyway.
say:19:1023104015:1.source_cn: 没说不帮他啊！这事情很简单——我们本来也要经过南村。
say:19:1023104015:1.male: Hey, I never said we wouldn't help him! This will be easy. We're passing through Southville anyway.
say:19:1023104015:1.female: Hey, I never said we wouldn't help him! This will be easy. We're passing through Southville anyway.

say:20:1023104016:1.text: Trust us with your letter. We shall deliver it to your beloved!
say:20:1023104016:1.source_cn: 把你的心意交给我们，我们帮你转交给你的心上人！

say:23:1023104018:1.text:
Well... I shall thank you in advance.
Please tell her that I'll be waiting where we promised!
say:23:1023104018:1.source_cn: 唉……那就先谢谢你们了。\n请帮我转达：我会在约定好的...

say:24:1023104019:1.text:
Whoa, I have never held another person's love letter. Is this how it's supposed to look?
The envelope doesn't look that special...
say:24:1023104019:1.source_cn: 哇哦，我还是第一次拿到别人的情书，原来是长这样子的？\...

say:25:1023104020:1.text: You want to see a couple more. I've got a bunch here.
say:25:1023104020:1.source_cn: 你对这些东西很感兴趣吗？我这里还有很多。

choice_prompt:26:1023104020.text: You want to see a couple more. I've got a bunch here.
choice_prompt:26:1023104020.source_cn: 你对这些东西很感兴趣吗？我这里还有很多。

choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 别想着偷看别人的隐私！

choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 你们两个别一唱一和的了……

choice:18:1:2.text: Let's find a way to help Jumeo!
choice:18:1:2.source_cn: 还是想办法帮帮朱密欧吧！
choice:18:1:2.male: Let's find a way to help Jumeo!
choice:18:1:2.female: Let's find a way to help Jumeo!

choice:2:0:1.text: Stay still. You have serious wounds.
choice:2:0:1.male: Stay still. You have serious wounds.
choice:2:0:1.female: Stay still. You have serious wounds.

say:0:1023104301:0.text: He seems like a nice old man... Let's ask him for directions.
say:0:1023104301:0.source_cn: 看来是位热心的老人家……不妨向他问问路。

say:2:1023104501:1.text: Good day, sir. Do you happen to know a young lady named Roliet?
say:2:1023104501:1.source_cn: 你好，尊敬的长者，请问您是否认识一位名叫罗丽叶的年轻小姐？

say:3:1023104502:1.text: Roliet, you must mean the girl walking about with that Jumeo from the village nearby!
say:3:1023104502:1.source_cn: 你们说的罗丽叶，是那个与邻村的朱密欧交往甚密的女孩吧！

say:4:1023104503:1.text: Yes. Do you know if they're talking to each other?
say:4:1023104503:1.source_cn: 没错，他们最近还保持着密切的联系吗？

say:5:1023104504:1.text: I'm not sure, but I do know that Roliet's father is a short-tempered old coot. I've never gotten along with him.
say:5:1023104504:1.source_cn: 噢，这个我可就不大清楚了。毕竟罗丽叶的父亲脾气实在是有...

say:0:1023106001:0.text: Maybe we can ask the villagers here...
say:0:1023106001:0.source_cn: 或许我们可以向这几位村民打听一下情况……

say:1:1023107001:1.text: Hello, did you say someone was fighting or arguing? What happened?
say:1:1023107001:1.source_cn: 嗨，听你们在说有人吵架，具体是什么情况？

say:2:1023107002:1.text: *Sigh*... We're used to it. Roliet and her father have been fighting over that poor boy from Northville. It's gotten worse these days...
say:2:1023107002:1.source_cn: 唉，我们已经司空见惯了。为了北村的那个穷小子，罗丽叶和...

say:4:1023107003:1.text: Sounds like Miss Roliet is just having a disagreement with her father. There's no need to fight, is there?
say:4:1023107003:1.source_cn: 听起来这位罗丽叶小姐和她父亲有些意见不合，他们为什么要吵架？

say:5:1023107004:1.text: Roliet doesn't want to be with anyone other than Jumeo, but her father doesn't approve of their relationship.
say:5:1023107004:1.source_cn: 这个罗丽叶，非要和北村的朱密欧在一起，可她父亲贾尔丹坚...

say:6:1023107005:1.text: She's been in an uproar this whole time. To stop his daughter from seeing that boy, Japulet has even barred the doors!
say:6:1023107005:1.source_cn: 小姑娘整天在家里搞得像要死要活的。为了阻止她去见那个男...

say:7:1023107006:1.text: That's why Jumeo wasn't able to see Roliet... She can't even go outside.
say:7:1023107006:1.source_cn: 难怪朱密欧说见不到罗丽叶……原来她根本走不出家门。

say:8:1023107007:1.text:
Japulet is being too harsh indeed if you ask me. Roliet hasn't eaten for days.
If it were me, I would never starve my own daughter.
say:8:1023107007:1.source_cn: 要说这贾尔丹也真够狠的，罗丽叶都绝食好几天了。\n换做...

choice_prompt:9:1023107007.text:
Japulet is being too harsh indeed if you ask me. Roliet hasn't eaten for days.
If it were me, I would never starve my own daughter.
choice_prompt:9:1023107007.source_cn: 要说这贾尔丹也真够狠的，罗丽叶都绝食好几天了。\n换做是我，我可舍不得让自己女儿饿肚子。

say:10:1023107008:3.text: Where does our Miss Roliet live?
say:10:1023107008:3.source_cn: 这位罗丽叶小姐的家在哪儿？

say:11:1023107009:1.text: Head northwest until you see a fully fenced house.
say:11:1023107009:1.source_cn: 喏，从这里往西北面走，看见那家围满栅栏的就是了。

say:12:1023107010:1.text: Why are you stepping into this mess...? You know that Japulet drove Jumeo away, right?
say:12:1023107010:1.source_cn: 你瞎凑什么热闹呀……你忘记被贾尔丹打出去的朱密欧了？

say:13:1023107011:1.text: I understand that you came to do a good deed, but this is better left alone. Japulet is known to be as stubborn as an old goat.
say:13:1023107011:1.source_cn: 几位贵客，我相信你们是出于善意前来，但是你们最好别去管...

choice:9:1:2.text: Looks like we have to step in!
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 看来这件事我们非管不可了！
choice:9:1:2.male: Looks like we have to step in!
choice:9:1:2.female: Looks like we have to step in!

say:0:1023109001:0.text: Northwest side... Fully fenced... Must be here!
say:0:1023109001:0.source_cn: 西北面……围满了栅栏……看来就是这里了！

say:2:1023109003:0.text: It's that stubborn father they were talking about!
say:2:1023109003:0.source_cn: 是那个传闻中很霸道的老头……老人家！

say:3:1023109004:0.text: What are you doing sneaking around here?!
say:3:1023109004:0.source_cn: 你们几个鬼鬼祟祟地在这里干什么！

say:2:1023110002:1.text: Terrible! You don't look like nice people! Stay away from my house!
say:2:1023110002:1.source_cn: 我不好，你看起来也不像什么好人！赶紧离开我的家门口！

say:3:1023110003:1.text: Please calm down, sir... We are just thirsty travelers passing by. Could we get a cup of water?
say:3:1023110003:1.source_cn: 老人家，不要这么激动嘛……我们只是路过的旅人，想喝口水...

say:4:1023110004:1.text: Do you not hear me?! <shk>Go away! I've got nothing here for you!</shk>
say:4:1023110004:1.source_cn: 你们是聋子吗？<shk>走开、走开！我这儿什么也没有！...

say:5:1023110005:1.text: He is a stubborn guy. Guess we can't see Roliet...
say:5:1023110005:1.source_cn: 唔……他这么固执，我们很难见到罗丽叶……

say:7:1023110006:1.text: Roliet! Did I say you can come out?! I told you to stay inside!
say:7:1023110006:1.source_cn: 罗丽叶！谁让你出来了？我不是让你待在屋子里吗？

say:8:1023110007:2.text: Stop daydreaming about him! It's just some outlanders. That penniless brat Jumeo is never coming back for you! N-E-V-E-R!
say:8:1023110007:2.source_cn: 别做白日梦了，只是几个路过的外乡人。朱密欧那个穷小子再...

say:10:1023110008:1.text: (Roliet! There she is! This might be the only chance we have to hand her the letter!)
say:10:1023110008:1.source_cn: （她就是罗丽叶！——这可能是我们能把信交给她的唯一机会了！）
say:10:1023110008:1.male: (Roliet! There she is! This might be the only chance we have to hand her the letter!)
say:10:1023110008:1.female: (Roliet! There she is! This might be the only chance we have to hand her the letter!)

choice_prompt:11:1023110008.text: (Roliet! There she is! This might be the only chance we have to hand her the letter!)
choice_prompt:11:1023110008.source_cn: （她就是罗丽叶！——这可能是我们能把信交给她的唯一机会了！）
choice_prompt:11:1023110008.male: (Roliet! There she is! This might be the only chance we have to hand her the letter!)
choice_prompt:11:1023110008.female: (Roliet! There she is! This might be the only chance we have to hand her the letter!)

say:12:1023110009:1.text: This is... Jumeo's handwriting! O Jumeo, Jumeo, wherefore art thou Jumeo? How am I left with only these words and sentences...?
say:12:1023110009:1.source_cn: 这是……是朱密欧的字迹！啊，我的朱密欧，我多么想见你，...

say:14:1023110010:1.text: That broke boy is at it again! I knew you outsiders were up to no good!
say:14:1023110010:1.source_cn: 又是那个该死的穷小子搞的花样！你们这些外乡人，果然没安...

say:16:1023110012:2.text: <shk>I can't believe he tore up the love letter!</shk>

say:18:1023110013:1.text: <shk>That was a letter from Jumeo!</shk> You had no right to do that!
say:18:1023110013:1.source_cn: <shk>这是朱密欧写给我的信！</shk>你凭什么撕...

say:19:1023110014:1.text: This is for your own good! Stop getting tricked by that sweet-talking liar!
say:19:1023110014:1.source_cn: 我现在做的一切都是为了你——不被那个只会花言巧语的骗子...

say:20:1023110015:1.text: Do you really think he wrote all those sweet words because he loves you? Wake up, my naive girl.
say:20:1023110015:1.source_cn: 别以为他是因为爱你才给你写那些肉麻话，天真的小姑娘！

say:21:1023110016:1.text: He's clearly after our family's money! Without gold and riches, how can you be happy?
say:21:1023110016:1.source_cn: 他分明是觊觎我们辛苦操劳半辈子得来的财富，没有帷帐和金...

say:22:1023110017:1.text: Let's go back inside! I forbid you from seeing that worthless liar!
say:22:1023110017:1.source_cn: 你跟我回去！我是不会让你有机会和那个混小子私会的！

say:23:1023110018:1.text:
Let go of me!
I need to see Jumeo! I must find him...
say:23:1023110018:1.source_cn: 你放开我！\n——我要去找朱密欧！我要去找他……

say:26:1023110019:1.text: ...I hate getting into people's business, but this old man is getting on my nerves.
say:26:1023110019:1.source_cn: ……我不喜欢惹麻烦，但这位老先生太不近人情了。

say:27:1023110020:1.text: What do we do? The love letter has been ripped up... Do we go and tell Jumeo about all of this?
say:27:1023110020:1.source_cn: 现在怎么办？情书也被撕了……要把事情的原委告诉朱密欧吗？

choice_prompt:28:1023110020.text: What do we do? The love letter has been ripped up... Do we go and tell Jumeo about all of this?
choice_prompt:28:1023110020.source_cn: 现在怎么办？情书也被撕了……要把事情的原委告诉朱密欧吗？

say:30:1023110021:1.text: Ah, oh! Something landed on Chippy's face!
say:30:1023110021:1.source_cn: 唔唔唔唔！有什么东西飞到满满脸上了！

say:31:1023110022:1.text: A piece of paper? Umm... there are words on it... Something about winds and fishes...
say:31:1023110022:1.source_cn: 这是什么……一张小纸片？上面还写着什么风，什么鱼……

say:34:1023110024:1.text: Chippy will try! Leave it to Chippy!
say:34:1023110024:1.source_cn: 唔……满满可以试试！就交给我吧！

choice:33:0:1.source_cn: 满满，你还能找到其他碎片吗？

choice:28:0:1.source_cn: 朱密欧一定会很伤心的……

choice:11:0:1.text: I have a letter for you.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 罗丽叶小姐，这里有你的信
choice:11:0:1.male: I have a letter for you.
choice:11:0:1.female: I have a letter for you.

say:0:1023113501:0.text: Chippy found the pieces to the letter!
say:0:1023113501:0.source_cn: 满满找到了！情书的碎片！

say:1:1023114001:0.text: If we piece this together, we can restore the love letter.
say:1:1023114001:0.source_cn: 把这些纸片都拼起来，就可以还原那封情书了吧？

say:3:1023114002:0.text: I'll do it! That way, I can take a peek... I mean, help Jumeo!
say:3:1023114002:0.source_cn: 交给我吧！正好可以看看——不，是可以帮朱密欧的忙！

say:6:1023114004:0.text: "Love is like the wind, and it never stays in place. My dear Roliet, I miss your sweet embrace!"
say:6:1023114004:0.source_cn: “爱像一阵风，吹完它就走。亲爱的罗丽叶，我多么想你呀！”

say:7:1023114005:0.text:
"I'm a fish out of water with you. I can't breathe or sleep, it's true."
Whoa, that's so vivid...
say:7:1023114005:0.source_cn: “看不到你的我，就像没水的鱼，扑腾着喘不过气来……”\...

say:8:1023114006:0.text: "You are like a mage casting the spell to keep me... not forgetting about you?"
say:8:1023114006:0.source_cn: “你就像个魔法师，让我对你念念不……忘”？

say:9:1023114007:0.text: "By the lakeside, we sealed our love with a kiss. I wander and stroll... I close my eyes, and your name fills my mind and soul..."
say:9:1023114007:0.source_cn: “我在我们定情一吻的湖边，每天游荡着不愿离去……每当我...

say:10:1023114008:0.text: "When I lose sight of you, there are no stars in the sky. There can be no star brighter than you, I always ask why?"—Hmm, this line is alright, I guess.
say:10:1023114008:0.source_cn: “见不到你的时候，我连星星都看不见，世界上哪有比你更亮...

say:11:1023114009:0.text: "You are my shiny star and a miracle of this world!" Hmm...ok...
say:11:1023114009:0.source_cn: “你不仅是我的星星，你是全世界的奇迹啊！”——啧啧啧……

say:14:1023114010:0.text: Well, I can tell he tried his best...

say:15:1023114012:0.text: Let's deliver the love letter to Miss Roliet first. As for what's written inside, I'll figure it out.
say:15:1023114012:0.source_cn: 咱们先去把情书送给罗丽叶小姐吧，至于这封情书的具体内容...

choice:12:0:1.text: Is it the best Jumeo can do?
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 这就是朱密欧的极限了吗？
choice:12:0:1.male: Is it the best Jumeo can do?
choice:12:0:1.female: Is it the best Jumeo can do?

say:17:1023114011:0.text: <hpy>Ah, this is my time to shine!</hpy>

choice:12:1:2.text: I want to help him edit this a bit...
choice:12:1:2.male: I want to help him edit this a bit...
choice:12:1:2.female: I want to help him edit this a bit...

say:3:1023115002:1.text: Shh! Be quiet! Let the night breeze take my message to Roliet.
say:3:1023115002:1.source_cn: 嘘！别声张！让晚风给罗丽叶捎个口信吧。

choice_prompt:4:1023115002.text: Shh! Be quiet! Let the night breeze take my message to Roliet.
choice_prompt:4:1023115002.source_cn: 嘘！别声张！让晚风给罗丽叶捎个口信吧。

say:5:1023115003:2.text: "Whisper in a zephyr's grace, convey my plea with tender trace—How I yearn for her embrace, <hpy>like a fish out of water, lost in space. On the edge of self-control's base, I ache in longing's endless chase.</hpy>"
say:5:1023115003:2.source_cn: “给我一阵清风替我告诉她——我多想念她，<hpy>宛如...

say:6:1023115004:1.text: "Grant me a breeze, my message carry, do implore. Of my deep devotion, for her, I cannot ignore. <hpy>Her name etched upon my heart, forever to adore. Love her like instinct, to my very core."</hpy>
say:6:1023115004:1.source_cn: 给我一阵清风替我告诉她——我多爱慕她，<hpy>她姓名...

say:7:1023115005:1.text: "In her presence, mundane days transform with grace. Into unending wonders, simple moments leave a magical trace."
say:7:1023115005:1.source_cn: 若与她同在，再平凡的日常，也会化作连绵不绝的奇迹。

say:8:1023115006:1.text: "Without her by my side, even the grandest view fades to shadows, losing its vibrant hue."
say:8:1023115006:1.source_cn: 若无她相伴，再美的风景，也变得黯然无光。

say:9:1023115007:1.text: "Alongside the lake, where our love's tale entwined. I wandered back and forth, reliving when our fates aligned."
say:9:1023115007:1.source_cn: 我在初定情缘的映湖旁徘徊，反反复复，流连忘返。

say:10:1023115008:1.text: "When distant from her, the stars cease to ignite. For in this world, no radiance matches her light so bright."
say:10:1023115008:1.source_cn: 与她相隔时，星光也不再闪烁……

say:11:1023115009:0.text: <hpy>"All things connected to her, in their splendor take flight. Miracles abound in her presence, day or night."</hpy>
say:11:1023115009:0.source_cn: <hpy>因为世上未曾有比她更璀璨的星星。一切与她相关...

say:13:1023115010:1.text: ...<hpy>That was amazing. Are you sure it's your first time writing a love letter?</hpy>
say:13:1023115010:1.source_cn: ……<hpy>写得不错啊，你真的是第一次写情书？</hpy>

choice:15:0:1.text: How do we deliver this letter to Roliet?
choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 怎么把这封信交给罗丽叶呢？
choice:15:0:1.male: How do we deliver this letter to Roliet?
choice:15:0:1.female: How do we deliver this letter to Roliet?

say:2:1023116001:1.text: It's you! Where is Jumeo? Is he here?
say:2:1023116001:1.source_cn: 是你们！朱密欧呢？他也来了吗？

say:3:1023116002:1.text: I'm sorry. He could not make it here with all his injuries.
say:3:1023116002:1.source_cn: 抱歉，他可能来不了——他受伤了。

say:4:1023116003:1.text: What?! Injuries?! Is he alright? It's not serious, is it?
say:4:1023116003:1.source_cn: 什么？受伤了？！他还好吗？没有大碍吧？

say:7:1023116004:1.text: That poor young man got driven off by your father, and then some gruglins dragged him to their lair...!
say:7:1023116004:1.source_cn: 那位可怜的先生，被你父亲拒绝后，又被咕布林拖进了巢穴……

say:11:1023116006:1.text:
Bunny-ears here is exaggerating a bit. He's fine now.
We plan to take you out of here so you two can be together.
say:11:1023116006:1.source_cn: 兔耳朵有点夸大其词，他现在已经脱离危险了。\n我们正在...

say:13:1023116008:1.text: Miss Roliet, please take a few steps back. My sword here is going to grant you your freedom...
say:13:1023116008:1.source_cn: 那么，罗丽叶小姐，请你后退几步，我手中的剑很快就会还你...

say:16:1023116011:1.text: The noise might wake my father... These can be unlocked with the spare key.
say:16:1023116011:1.source_cn: 动静太大可能会吵醒我父亲……可以用备用钥匙打开这些栅栏。

choice_prompt:17:1023116011.text: The noise might wake my father... These can be unlocked with the spare key.
choice_prompt:17:1023116011.source_cn: 动静太大可能会吵醒我父亲……可以用备用钥匙打开这些栅栏。

say:18:1023116012:1.text: He hid the key under the grapes!
say:18:1023116012:1.source_cn: 他把钥匙藏在了葡萄架下面！

say:19:1023116013:1.text: Alright, leave it to us. Just wait here, and we'll be right back.
say:19:1023116013:1.source_cn: 交给我们吧，你在这里等着，我们会尽快回来。

say:20:1023116014:0.text: Thank you. Please take care of yourselves!
say:20:1023116014:0.source_cn: 谢谢你们，我等着你们的好消息，请万般小心！

say:0:1023117001:0.text: Found it! Let's return to Roliet!
say:0:1023117001:0.source_cn: 找到钥匙了，我们快回去找罗丽叶！
say:0:1023117001:0.male: Found it! Let's return to Roliet!
say:0:1023117001:0.female: Found it! Let's return to Roliet!

say:1:1023118001:0.text: You have the key! Yes, that's the one! I can't thank you enough!
say:1:1023118001:0.source_cn: 就是这把钥匙没错！谢谢你们！

say:2:1023118002:0.text: We need to leave right now. He's going to be furious if he catches me escaping...
say:2:1023118002:0.source_cn: 我们得赶紧离开这里，不然万一我父亲醒来发现我离家出走，...

say:0:1023119001:0.text: Gruglins again! Isn't that too often lately?
say:0:1023119001:0.source_cn: 又是咕布林，最近他们骚扰村庄是不是太频繁了。

say:2:1023119003:0.text: They're the ones who hurt my Jumeo! They must pay!
say:2:1023119003:0.source_cn: 就是他们伤害了我亲爱的朱密欧！我不会放过他们！

say:1:1023120002:0.source_cn: 不行！我一刻也等不了了！

say:2:1023120003:0.text: How do you know he's in that direction?
say:2:1023120003:0.source_cn: 你怎么知道朱密欧在那个方向？

say:3:1023120004:0.text: That's where we fell in love!
say:3:1023120004:0.source_cn: 他一定在那里！那是我们定情的地方！

say:5:1023121001:0.text: Roliet! I thought I would never see you again... I've been waiting here all this time!
say:5:1023121001:0.source_cn: 罗丽叶！我以为我再也见不到你了……我一直这里在等你！

say:6:1023121002:0.text: Jumeo, I missed you! I heard that you're hurt, are you alright? Let me see.
say:6:1023121002:0.source_cn: 朱密欧，我也一直在思念你！听说你受伤了，伤的重吗？让我看看。

say:7:1023121003:0.text: You know, I'd walk a thousand miles if I could just see you.
say:7:1023121003:0.source_cn: 能够见到你，再重的伤又算得上什么呢？

say:8:1023121004:0.text: Jumeo, nothing will ever separate us from now on!
say:8:1023121004:0.source_cn: 朱密欧，从今往后，再也没有什么能把我们分开了！

narration:11:1023153:0.text: With your guidance, Jumeo and Roliet finally reunite.
narration:11:1023153:0.source_cn: 在你们的引路下，罗丽叶与朱密欧终于重逢。
